caption: The video captures a stationary outdoor view of a leaf-strewn clearing bordered by bare winter trees, with a rough trunk in the left foreground and a yellow hose near the bottom right. A long mound of dry brown leaves sits in the middle ground beside a nearby patch of bare dirt. A fire is already burning on the leaf pile, appearing as a compact orange-yellow flame rising from the center-right of the mound. Across the visible sequence the flame steadily thickens and spreads horizontally along the pile, with additional burning patches emerging toward the left while leaves in the active zone are lifted and churned upward. The foreground tree, dirt path, and yellow hose remain fixed, and the bright growing fire still occupies the leaf mound throughout the visible portion.
